results.rationale: Consistency: glass, water level, tabletop, board and laboratory background persist; an unrequested second pencil is added. Instruction: pencils are inserted through the water surface to the glass bottom, but there are two rather than one. Knowledge: slight offset/thickening is visible at the surface, suggesting refraction, though the submerged shafts remain nearly collinear and the expected broken appearance is weak. Quality: coherent glass/reflections and pencil placement; the yellow pencil’s upper end has a small odd exposed-wood/red-cap construction.

Consistency: black helmet, red stripe/vent design, dark visor and gray backdrop remain, with changed reflections attributable to viewpoint. Instruction: helmet becomes front-facing horizontally, but the camera remains elevated, showing a much larger crown and sloped visor edge than the straight-on reference; partial viewpoint match. Quality: smooth coherent helmet surfaces, clean trim and natural gloss without noticeable artifacts.
